statusLegend.proven: Current local evidence proves the requirement.
statusLegend.partial: Local evidence proves the contract, but live behavior or a real handoff is still unproven.

requirements.requirement: Provide a project-neutral Paperclip Cockpit QA runtime that accepts config, suite, Telegram/Paperclip credentials and outputs manifests, reports, bugs, cleanup results, and Telegram summaries.
Keep Inner Agora-specific target bot, Paperclip company, suites, phrases, expectations, cleanup policy, and guard warnings in telegram-testing.config.json.
Provide a Codex plugin/skill that separates tester, developer, retest, and release-review modes.
Require health/readiness and explicit acknowledgement before live Telegram/Paperclip side effects.
Cleanup must delete or hide only Telegram/Paperclip artifacts listed in the manifest or carrying the exact run marker.
Tester mode can produce grouped bug batches that developer mode can consume one area at a time.
requirements.remainingEvidence: A real failing live manifest and developer handoff have not yet been exercised.

requirements.requirement: Retest mode reruns failed test ids and proves whether bugs are fixed, still failing, or changed.
requirements.remainingEvidence: A real live failed-then-fixed cycle has not yet been exercised.

requirements.requirement: A controlled live help suite run passes or produces accepted bug output and cleans itself.
requirements.remainingEvidence: Requires explicit operator approval and a live run with --live-ok.
